harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-26, before any result (the full-game program, borg-zoo#805). The ladder of the 1M pilot on the same specimen (a0b73ca9): the same 9 starts (subset, same seeds/classes/births) at a 3,000,000-turn cap - the engine is deterministic, so the first 1,000,000 turns replay the 1M pilot exactly and the games continue. Report per game: max CL, max DL, outcome (death with cause and turn, or alive at the cap), the CL timeline; CL20 count over all games. Descriptive (RULES 14); the ladder continues on the owner's word. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell ends in death or turn_cap (a stall is a finding of its own).
